scope: Prospective evidence contract only; sources unchanged, no computation, test, new physical/scientific result or remote issue action.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Matched article, atmosphere, mass and phase state
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Question 3; ENERGY-CLOSURE-2026-10.md What this model leaves out
entries.units: kg; m3; kg/m3; Pa; K; altitude m MSL; s
entries.method: Request complete article/inclusion identity, geometry, onboard inventories and pressure/temperature/altitude histories synchronized with the same control, phase, basis and time records.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Assumed dry target, standard atmosphere or different inventories cannot establish the dynamic response of a built vehicle. Quasi-static force/bus closure remains conditional.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Observed vertical motion and phase joins
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Dynamic replan: what trajectory and load schedule can close together?; ENERGY-CLOSURE-2026-10.md Signed vertical authority screen of the served candidates, acceleration estimate
entries.units: m; m/s signed; m/s2 signed; s; coordinate identity
entries.method: Request calibrated altitude, velocity and acceleration histories with time synchronization, sample/processing provenance, missing intervals, uncertainty and both sides of each phase transition.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: A prescribed altitude curve, sampled second difference or C1 join does not establish realizable acceleration or actuator response; a release-only change does not establish full-cycle cost.

entries.existing_model_reference: docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Shape-specific added mass: what coefficient belongs to the capsule?; ENERGY-CLOSURE-2026-10.md Signed vertical authority screen of the served candidates, inertial mass
entries.units: kg; dimensionless coefficient; m3; kg/m3; attitude rad; s
entries.method: Request capsule-specific geometry and flow/model provenance plus unsteady, viscous, appendage, attitude and experimental evidence; retain coefficient/tensor axes, local density and volume, calibration and uncertainty.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Existing hull-only spheroid surrogates and sensitivity pair are not measured capsule data. Geometry or flow/attitude mismatch and excluded load/control dynamics prevent transfer.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Actual signed actuator/control authority and electrical response
entries.existing_model_reference: ENERGY-CLOSURE-2026-10.md Signed vertical authority screen of the served candidates, signed force balance; docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Dynamic replan: what trajectory and load schedule can close together?
entries.units: N signed; N/s; W; W/s; response time s; coordinate identity
entries.method: Request simultaneous force-owner, rotor/control-command and actual-response observations in both directions with blade/speed/pitch policy, bus limits, uncertainty and shared phase/seam timing.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Buoyancy is already in the ledger. Shedding downward thrust cannot supply unavailable upward authority. Constant hover merit times drive efficiency and an unverified cap do not qualify actuator response or signed reserve.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Suspended bag and cable transient load reaching the hull
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Bag and cable: what load history reaches the hull?; ENERGY-CLOSURE-2026-10.md What this model leaves out
entries.units: N; kg; m; m/s; angle rad; W; s
entries.method: Request matched bag geometry/immersion/inventory, water-flow and entrained mass, cable stiffness/damping/slack, tension, swing and winch ramp histories synchronized with hull and bus records.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Quasi-static cable support and steady hoist work omit pickup shocks, pendulum motion and actuator coupling. Hull-only acceleration screening cannot fill these observations.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Mission completion, chronological stores and thermal applicability
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Endurance frame: what mission can the stores support? and Necessary stored energy, ideal accounting
entries.units: Wh; W; kg nitrogen; usable SoC fraction; K; s
entries.method: Request an authorized mission horizon and terminal state with synchronized electrical/nitrogen inventories, initial conditions, usable SoC, losses, health, thermal policy, contingency/reserve and recharge observations.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Published ideal lossless accounting is a necessary-energy diagnostic, not a mission-completion or battery qualification verdict. Initial nitrogen is charged storage; nominal capacity and day-average solar do not establish an operational schedule.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Evidence provenance, adverse conditions and unchanged failed searches
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Question 3; ENERGY-CLOSURE-2026-10.md Signed vertical authority screen of the served candidates, withdrawn absolute diagnostic
entries.units: record identity; calibration identity; time/coordinate basis; uncertainty units
entries.method: Request raw observations, calibration and processing provenance, matched-state comparison, uncertainty components/correlations and missing-data flags; preserve failed trials and both successful/failed search records separately.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: No full-payload profile meets the control reserve target in the stated published search. The withdrawn absolute inertial diagnostic missed upward authority; retain it as dated history, not an acceptance rule or broad impossibility proof.
